# mtncloud_floating_ips (Data Source)

Lists the floating (public) IPs attached to your instances, with the instance each one is on. Give an instance a floating IP with `floating_ip_pool` on `mtncloud_instance`. Floating IPs not attached to an instance aren't listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Public IPs on the instances of one project; leave project out for all of them.
data "mtncloud_floating_ips" "web" {
  project = "web-prod"
}

output "public_ips" {
  value = { for f in data.mtncloud_floating_ips.web.floating_ips : f.ip => f.instance }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project` (String) Only list IPs on instances in this project (for example `web-prod`; the full platform name also works).

### Read-Only

- `floating_ips` (Attributes List) The floating IPs, sorted by address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))

<a id="nestedatt--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `instance` (String) Name of the instance it is on.
- `instance_id` (Number) ID of the instance it is on.
- `ip` (String) The public address.
- `private_ip` (String) The instance's private address it forwards to.
- `project` (String) The instance's project, without the tenant suffix.
